notes: Master channel, measured on AE 2026 8 bpc, straight 8-bit colour, L = (max + min)/2: Master Hue (degrees) = HLS hue rotation keeping max and min (+120 = (r,g,b) -> (b,r,g), bit-exact). Master Saturation < 0: chroma scaled about L by k = 1 + Sat * 2.55/256 (AE's 8-bit step: -60 -> 103/256 = 0.40234; k = 0.4 is off by 1 on 20 % of the pixels, the LP-feasible range is 0.4022..0.4025). Master Lightness: > 0 blends towards white (c + (1 - c) Lt), < 0 towards black (c (1 + Lt)), Lt = Light/100. Colorize (AE 6 = 1): HLS(Colorize Hue, Colorize Saturation/100, L), bit-exact. One half-up rounding; alpha untouched. Residual: 30 opaque pixels where AE rounds an exact .5 tie of the mid channel down. NOT measured (no visible reference): Master Saturation > 0 (Photoshop formula: inc = Sat*2.55/256, a = inc + S >= 1 ? S : 1 - inc, rgb += (rgb - L)(1/a - 1)), Master Lightness < 0, Colorize Lightness (applied like Master Lightness), hue angles other than multiples of 120 (exact .5 ties may round differently, cf. color_balance_hls). AE 1 Channel Control other than Master and AE 2 Channel Range (per-colour ranges) are not reproduced: only the Master values are used.
